title: The Midnight Signal
excerpt: Every Tuesday at 2:14 AM, the old radio tower on Pine Ridge broadcasts a sequence nobody can decode.
content: The static always cleared three seconds before the tone began.

Leo leaned closer to the desk, adjusting the brass dial until the green phosphor glow of the oscilloscope steadied into a clean sine wave. He had been logging the transmissions since October, filling three spiral notebooks with rows of numbers that refused to match any known cipher.
Tonight, however, the pattern changed. Instead of the usual five-pulse cadence, the speaker crackled with a single, unmistakable voice.

title: The Lantern Market
excerpt: At the edge of the harbor, merchants trade memories instead of silver.
content: You never bring coins to the Lantern Market. You bring a jar, a cork, and something you are willing to forget.

Mara kept her hand wrapped tightly around the glass bottle in her coat pocket. Inside swirled a faint silver mist—the memory of her seventh birthday, traded away for a compass that only pointed toward lost things.
